name: Mem0 MCP Server
summary: Hosted MCP server that gives agents Mem0 memory tools to save, search and update memories stored in a Mem0 Platform account.
description: Add with `npx mcp-add --type http --url https://mcp.mem0.ai/mcp`. Clients sign in through a browser OAuth flow; headless clients can send a Mem0 API key as a bearer token.

agent_access.notes: API key as Bearer token for headless clients.
